sampling_note: The provider does not expose a controlled sampling seed; repeats are independent API trajectories at temperature 0.2.

execution.parallelism: two workers within a layer; arms and layers sequential

decision_rule.performance_signal: Compare layer-wise normalized Core score by mode across all three repeats.
decision_rule.complexity_signal: Compare received experience characters and total input tokens across layers.
decision_rule.causal_caution: Treat a single failed worker as stochastic unless the direction repeats in at least two of three replicates.

interpretation: Engineering replication for go/no-go decisions; not final manuscript evidence.
